ava: Quick sync — who is responsible for counting degraded-mode fallbacks vs runtime-level errors (timeouts/5xx/OOM)?

jordan: my take: runtime should emit raw events (counters/histograms) with reason tags, platform should own aggregation, alerting windows, and dashboard materialization.

sam: agree with split. need to call out cardinality constraints — per-route+model can explode. recommend route_id + model_family tag, not full route path.

tia: runtime can add a new metric set. proposal: `redwood_runtime.fallback_count` (tag: reason=[oom,timeout,5xx,degraded], model, deploy_env), `redwood_runtime.request_latency_ms` histogram, `redwood_runtime.oom_events` counter. example line (prometheus exposition):
```
# HELP redwood_runtime_fallback_count fallback events emitted by runtime
# TYPE redwood_runtime_fallback_count counter
redwood_runtime_fallback_count{reason="timeout",model_family="gptx-7b",env="prod",route_bucket="customer_apps"} 3
```

mira: for Console dashboards we need: 1) per-model-family fallback rate over time, 2) top routes by fallback count, 3) time-to-first-fallback after deploy. Also want a boolean signal for "degraded mode" occurrences.

jordan: platform will consume the runtime counters and produce derived metrics: `platform.fallback_rate_per_1k_requests`, `platform.degraded_mode_active{route}`, and materialized top-n by route. platform will also normalize reason values.

sam: alerting asks: who sets SLI semantics? if fallback_rate > X for 5m -> P1? Ops wants deterministic semantics.

ava: decision: runtime emits raw counters + reason tag; platform owns normalized derived metrics, dashboards, and alerts. document spec in metric-contracts repo.

tia: implementation note: adding tags increases cardinality. we'll add `route_bucket` (low-card) and `route_id` (high-card, sampled). propose emitting route_id only for 1% of events (sampling) and always emit route_bucket.
mira: Console needs exact mapping from route_bucket -> human-friendly name. platform to provide mapping endpoint or static join table.

jordan: ownership summary for PR: runtime (tia) add metrics and docs; platform (jordan) add normalization pipeline + derived metrics; console (mira) will build dashboard templates and alerts; SRE (sam) will review alert thresholds.

ava: next steps: tia to open runtime PR with proto + example lines by EOD Thu; jordan to draft normalization spec and retention policy; mira to mock dashboard tiles. sync Wed 10am.

devops-bot: Deploy notice — runtime/edge v2.14 rolled to canary (10%) at 1925004415. No errors. :white_check_mark:

sam: one more ask — capture latency distribution on fallback vs successful path. add `request_latency_ms{path="success|fallback"}` or a label `outcome`.
tia: ack, will include `outcome` label.

ava: thanks all — I'll create the metric-contracts issue and link here.
